name: linora-compliance
description: Linora compliance intelligence portal, backed by the existing authenticated Next.js application.

COMPLIANCE_PORTAL_MODE.description: Use the compliance workspace as the root landing page.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.description: HTTPS Supabase project URL. Public configuration; required at build time.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Supabase publishable browser key (never use a secret role key here).

SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.description: Server-only key for tenant-scoped compliance writes. Never prefix with NEXT_PUBLIC_.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: The canonical HTTPS origin used for Supabase Auth callbacks.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional server-only Groq token; manual workflows function without it.
